newsitem.title: UK: BP profit up despite margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: BP profit up despite margin pressure.

text.p: Oil giant British Petroleum Co Plc announced a strong rise in third-quarter profits Tuesday despite downward pressure on its profit margins in refining, marketing and chemicals.

BP said net earnings before exceptional items in the three months to Sept. 30 rose 22 percent to 650 million pounds ($1.07 billion) from 532 million ($879 million) a year earlier. The results were toward the top of analysts' forecasts of net earnings between 600 million and 675 million pounds ($992 million and $1.1 billion).
For the first nine months of the year net earnings jumped 28 percent to a record 1.93 billion pounds ($3.19 billion) on a replacement cost basis.
BP said productivity gains more than offset a slightly weaker operating environment, with higher oil prices making up for lower profit margins on chemicals.

Crude oil prices rose during the third quarter, helped by strong demand, low stock levels and uncertainty about Iraqi exports. BP said these factors were likely to underpin oil prices, which have risen to their highest levels since the Gulf War, in the near term.
It said oil and gas output this year would probably be 4 percent above 1995 levels.
